_comment: Copy to config/prod.json (gitignored) and fill in. Build with --flavor prod --dart-define-from-file=config/prod.json. The ADMOB_* values are the existing live AdMob ad unit ids (AdMob console, app 12 Step Guide; the native apps had them in _Constants.swift / _Constants.java and strings.xml). Leave a value empty and that advert format stays off. They stay out of git because a value baked into a release cannot be changed without another release. Dev and staging always use Google's test units.
